recitation.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ اَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ اَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوْتُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ

transliteration.id: allahumma bika amsainaa wa bika ashbahnaa wa bika nahyaa wa bika namuutu wa ilaikal mashiir
transliteration.en: allahumma bika amsainaa wa bika ashbahnaa wa bika nahyaa wa bika namuutu wa ilaikal mashiir

translation.id: Ya Allah, karena Engkau kami mengalami waktu petang dan waktu pagi, karena Engkau kami hidup dan mati dan kepada-Mu juga kami akan kembali.
translation.en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.
